---
title: revalidateTag
---

`revalidateTag` invalidates cached data on demand for a cache tag.

## Parameters

```ts
revalidateTag(tag: string, profile: string | { expire?: number }): void;
```

- `tag`: the cache tag to invalidate.
- `profile`: how the entry is revalidated. `'max'` (recommended) marks it stale and serves it while fresh data loads in the background.

The single-argument form `revalidateTag(tag)` is deprecated since Next.js 16. For read-your-writes in a Server Action, use `updateTag`.
